{"status": "ok", "comment": "Implemented the chunked(seq, size) helper in utils/batch.py to split a sequence into ordered chunks of at most `size` items, with the last chunk carrying the remainder, satisfying the tests and README contract.", "file_path": "utils/batch.py", "content": """"Shared batching helpers.

Three call sites need chunked(): feed a sequence and a size, get lists of at
most `size` items, in order, with the last chunk carrying the remainder.
"""


def chunked(seq, size: int):
    """Split *seq* into ordered chunks of at most *size* items.

    The last chunk takes the remainder, so a sequence smaller than *size*
    yields a single chunk containing the whole sequence.
    """
    return [seq[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(seq), size)]
